title: When does diversity collapse? Mapping the temperature/decoding boundary of inter-model homogeneity

original_idea.body:
# When does diversity collapse?

Sweep temperature/top-p across several open models on fixed prompts; measure inter-model similarity and intra-model diversity, find the boundary where outputs stop converging, and test whether high-temp diversity is genuine. Sampling + embedding analysis.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (decoding boundary informs cheap mitigation) but catastrophic link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: temperature/top-p sweep with similarity/embedding metrics; standard tooling.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped parameter sweep with a clear boundary-detection deliverable.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: open models + sampling, weak lab incentive, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Sampling sweep across several models + embeddings, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Decoding effects on diversity studied; the inter-model collapse boundary may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Boundary-condition extension of an existing effect; plausibly open.
